description: Check whether a seller has answered an introduction created by demand.request_introduction, and read their reply. Call it when the user asks whether the dealer got back to them. Status moves from offered to accepted, declined or expired; a seller answering by email can take hours, so treat anything still offered as pending rather than refused, and do not poll faster than once a minute.

introduction_id.description: The id returned by demand.request_introduction. Keep it from that response; it is the only handle on the introduction.

name: demand.introduction_status
title: Check an introduction for a seller reply
